description: Private places, unreadable-preferences protection and compatible saved-tab schema
Single-worker navigation, ordered tab-session restoration and independent tab sorting
Stage, validate, sign and verify cached macOS app bundles before safe publication

Classify Automatic theme using file extensions only; honor explicit Silver/Midnight/Aurora. Picture majority selects Aurora, code majority Midnight, mixed/empty Silver. MUST NOT inspect document contents.
Metadata-aware descriptor-relative staged copy and exclusive same-volume move with recoverable failures
Expose core, appearance, model and bundle modules without AppKit initialization, so deterministic tests can run without a display.

Dispatch optional PATH, --help, --self-test and installer-only --install-bundle STAGED DESTINATION. Reject unknown flags/extra arguments; CLI help and bundle publication MUST NOT initialize AppKit. Resolve relative CLI paths against process cwd. Native UI starts on initial thread.

Publish a complete staged bundle with Darwin renamex_np RENAME_EXCL. Atomic collision failure MUST NOT replace, merge or alter either staged or installed bundle. Return io::Result; non-macOS reports Unsupported. Preserve collision regression tests.

Install current bundle per-user in ~/Applications/Personal Files.app. Refuse existing destination, build, ditto to a unique sibling staging directory, then invoke non-GUI exclusive atomic publication. MUST NOT overwrite/merge with an existing or concurrently installed app or require sudo. On failure retain staging with readable status.
Rebuild then exec the cached app binary forwarding arguments, ensuring source changes cannot run a stale binary. MUST NOT replace Finder or require sudo.

Run formatting, warnings-denied Clippy, locked deterministic tests, explicit native fixture, native release bundle build and plist/signature checks. MUST NOT claim foreground routing passed if the fixture reports it unverified.
